BuffEffect.description: What a buff does while it's on.

oneOf.description:
Changes a stat. `stat`: a name the server knows (`damage`, `defense`, `max_health`,
`move_speed`, `build_speed`, `special_recharge`, `normal_recharge`, `health_regen`,
`mitigation`, `orb_chance`, ...) or a client stat name or number. `value`: a number,
`"20%"`, or `"amount"` / `"amount * 0.5"` (the buff's amount, or the caller's).
Deals its holder's damage as this type (elemental damage).

Changes a skill of its holder (`normal`, `special` or `skill/...`): more projectiles,
faster recharge, ...
Replaces a shortcut's skill while on (stances, combos: OverrideShortcut).
A client game action as the client's data has it.

commands and their arguments).

pos.description: An exact position (instead of a point).

prompt.description: Ask first ("Do you want to travel to X?").

world.description: The world (`world/...`); none: the same world.

101]`: the caster has upgrade 448001; 91: hasn't).

channelling.description: Only while the holder channels a special.

lockout.description: Can't go off again for this long.

oneOf.description: Any attack of its holder hits.
The holder attacks (hit or not).
The holder is hit.
The holder smashes an enemy.
The holder's health drops below `below`.
The holder hasn't been hit for `after`.
Every `every_time`.
The holder smashes a smashable.
The holder builds a buildie.

texts.80:
{startfxpackageonactor knubotOwnerActor 239915}
[Swashbuckler]I am Swashbuckler, you've probably heard of me, no? The most fearsome and beautiful pirate in all of Pirate World?
texts.81:
{startfxpackageonactor knubotOwnerActor 239915}
[Swashbuckler]I've languished in this prison. They don't even have a mirror! Let's break out of here.
texts.207:
{movecameratoactor Officer}
[Guard Captain]Why did you destroy our wall? What did the wall ever do to you? That was my favorite wall.
texts.208: [Guard Captain]There is a serious lack of respect for walls in this place. Islanders, Pirates and now this?!
texts.209:
{startfxpackageonactor Officer 66089}
[Guard Captain]Throw this vandal in jail! I've had enough with people damaging my walls!
texts.225: [Swashbuckler]Let's see if we can find us a way out! I'll watch yer back!
texts.743:
[Emote]{startfxpackageonactor knubotOwnerActor 239914}
[Gamer]What!? He stole the CRYSTAL COMPASS? Purple pixels! We've got to catch him!
texts.748:
{movecameratoactor knubotOwnerActor}
[Gamer]Help me smash a way through!
texts.753:
[Talk]{startfxpackageonactor knubotOwnerActor 239915}
[Gamer]Follow me, I know a shortcut!
texts.790: [Video Game Guy]Dreadleg is up to no good! We should warn our friends in the Pirate World!
texts.791: [Video Game Guy]At least we managed to recover the Crystal Compass. Legend says that it will always point to where you need to go next.
texts.816: [Gamer]I'm afraid I can't guide you in this World. But my friend, Swashbuckler can!
texts.824: [Swashbuckler]Those Jackets threw me in jail for asking around about Dreadleg. That scallywag is up to no good!
texts.825: [Swashbuckler]If we're going to have an adventure and figure this out, we are going to need to put a crew together! And I know just the right folks for the job!
texts.826: [Swashbuckler]Let's start with my friend the Island Warrior. He's the best tracker in Pirate World and with his help, we can put together a crew of the toughest figures that exist!
texts.827: [Swashbuckler]Last time I saw him he was going to explore the Monkey Cave. Let's start there! Onwards to adventure!
texts.854: [Video Game Guy]Let's use it to go after Dreadleg!
texts.1026: [Monster Scientist]Who among you dares to illustrate, elevate, immolate, detonate, integrate, inundate, eliminate, simulate, investigate and above all, participate in my travelling monster show?
texts.1031:
{movecameratopos Cine_DefendPos1}
[Monster Scientist]And so, I must facilitate a special fate. My henchman shall participate to smash that THING of silicate. If you can mitigate and eliminate their threat then I'll capitulate!
texts.1037: [Monster Scientist]I have heart rate, growth state, liver weight and length of gait to pontificate. And with that I can reintegrate and invigorate my monsters.
texts.1039: [Monster Scientist]This data is amazing! You are a hero beyond my ability to articulate.
texts.1040: [Monster Scientist]Return again to participate. Fresh data is my mandate and you are an exceptional candidate!
texts.1042: [Monster Scientist]Ah a ticket! Then let us not equivocate, pontificate or manipulate. Alas, I hesitate to irritate but could you sign here to meet your fate?
texts.1043: [Monster Scientist]By doing so you stipulate that in the case that you detonate, immolate, dissipate or disintegrate you will vindicate Monster Scientists Inc of the cost to rehabilitate or renumerate.
texts.1044: [Monster Scientist]All signed? Then let us initiate!
